$comment: Reforged engine source pin for the Android integration. The Android build checks out THIS commit into reforged-engine/ and verifies it before applying any adaptation layer. Update procedure: change 'commit' (and 'commit_message'/'pinned_on'), then RE-DERIVE and re-verify the Android adaptation layer (reforged/android-adaptation/patches/) against the new revision -- the patches are NOT expected to apply to an arbitrary newer commit. Never use a floating 'main' for production builds.
pin_rationale: This is the olcay revision that louay0khaled/zero-hour-reforged-android-mod pins (REFORGED_PIN) and against which its Android adaptation layer (reforged-c1-android.patch + reforged-c4-game-library.patch, after reforged-frame-selfcheck-entry.patch) is verified to apply and to produce the Android shared-library target (add_library(rfx_game SHARED ...)). Newer olcay main (e.g. b79aa63) does NOT accept the C4 patch without re-derivation of ~14.8k lines, which cannot be verified without a build; pinning here is the only build-achievable configuration. Verified locally: c1 + frame-selfcheck-entry + frame-selfcheck-mali-tolerances + c4 all apply cleanly (git apply --check) and the CMake target is present.
license: GPL-3.0-only (see LICENSE.md in the engine tree)
game_assets: NOT included. The user supplies their own legally-owned Zero Hour game data; the build never downloads or packages game assets.

third_party.note: Fetched by the engine's own Tools/vendor.sh at pinned commits (run after checkout, before rfx-jni-prefix/gamespy-pthread patches). Recorded here for traceability.

ffmpeg.source: Tools/ffmpeg-build-posix.sh (built for the Android target via C4's FFMPEG_POSIX_CFLAGS)

miniaudio.source: vendored under GeneralsMD/Code/Libraries/Source/miniaudio (header-only, compiled into the engine)

adaptation_layer.note: Android-specific changes applied to the checked-out engine at build time (never committed into the engine tree). Vendored verbatim from louay (pinned adaptation_louay_pin) under reforged/android-adaptation/patches/, applied in the order below by scripts/build/android/build-reforged-engine.sh.
order: ( run Tools/vendor.sh here to populate SDL3/GameSpy/FreeType/glslang )
